project.name: Novere
project.description: Independent x86-64 kernel in C, pursuing progressive Windows NT binary compatibility.

subsystems.name: UEFI boot
subsystems.notes: ExitBootServices transaction, pinned handoff and an owned kernel stack; no independent image loader.

subsystems.name: CPU and exceptions
subsystems.notes: GDT, IDT, TSS and IST; fatal exceptions only. AP startup, APIC and IRQ dispatch are pending.

subsystems.name: Physical memory
subsystems.notes: Sparse PFN database, references, generation checks and synchronized allocation; VMM, pools and paging are pending.

subsystems.name: Diagnostics
subsystems.notes: Bounded serial records and terminal crash context; dump persistence, unwinder and module list are pending.

subsystems.name: Scheduler
subsystems.notes: Priority ready queues, wait ownership, affinity and preemption contract; implementation pending.

subsystems.name: Dispatcher
subsystems.notes: Wait blocks, signal consumption, timeout arbitration and cancellation; implementation pending.

subsystems.name: IRQL and interrupt routing
subsystems.notes: IRQL must bind interrupt masks, local preemption and APIC priority. No emulated IRQL variable.

subsystems.name: DPC / APC
subsystems.notes: Per-CPU deferred work and thread-owned APC queues require the scheduler and interrupt model.

subsystems.name: Object manager
subsystems.notes: Reference and handle ownership, namespace, security hooks and deferred destruction.

subsystems.name: PE and driver loading
subsystems.notes: Untrusted PE32+ validation, dependency transactions, unwind registration and rollback.

subsystems.name: I/O manager
subsystems.notes: Single IRP completion owner, cancellation arbitration, stack locations and device references.

subsystems.name: Plug and Play
subsystems.notes: Device tree, PDO/FDO/filter lifetimes and removal state machine.

subsystems.name: Power
subsystems.notes: Power state coordination, device quiescence and PnP interaction.

subsystems.name: Security and integrity
subsystems.notes: Tokens, SIDs, ACLs and trust-preserving image admission.

subsystems.name: Registry
subsystems.notes: Typed values, key lifetimes, handles, security checks and ordered notifications.

subsystems.name: Processes and threads
subsystems.notes: Address-space ownership, kernel stacks, handle tables, rundown and thread lifecycle.

subsystems.name: IPC
subsystems.notes: Endpoint ownership, messages, cancellation and quotas.

subsystems.name: HAL
subsystems.notes: ACPI discovery, timers, interrupt controllers and DMA/MMIO contracts.

apis.name: KeWaitForSingleObject
apis.prototype: NTSTATUS KeWaitForSingleObject(PVOID Object, KWAIT_REASON WaitReason, KPROCESSOR_MODE WaitMode, BOOLEAN Alertable, PLARGE_INTEGER Timeout);
apis.irql: <= APC_LEVEL for a blocking wait; <= DISPATCH_LEVEL only for zero timeout.
apis.blocking: Conditional; supports finite or infinite waits, alerts and APC interactions.
apis.notes: No export exists. Requires dispatcher, scheduler, timers and APC semantics.

apis.name: IoCallDriver
apis.blocking: Dispatch can complete synchronously or return pending; contract research required.
apis.notes: WDK macro, not an independently established binary export. IofCallDriver is the underlying routine.

apis.name: KeRaiseIrql
apis.irql: NewIrql must be >= current IRQL; architecture binding pending.
apis.notes: WDK macro contract. No internal or binary implementation is provided.

milestones.title: Foundation and evidence
milestones.deliverables: UEFI ownership transition, PFN contracts, CPU exceptions, diagnostics, host/VM tests and official portal.

milestones.title: Owned address space
milestones.deliverables: Page-table manager, explicit mappings, guard pages, W^X, TLB invalidation, pools, MDLs and reservation reclamation.

milestones.title: Interrupts and execution
milestones.deliverables: ACPI, APIC, timers, AP startup, per-CPU state, IRQL, scheduler and DPC.

milestones.title: Executive and object lifetimes
milestones.deliverables: Processes, dispatcher waits, APC, Object Manager, handles and security primitives.

milestones.title: Native driver model
milestones.deliverables: PE loader, module lifetime, I/O, cancellation, PnP, registry and native test drivers.

milestones.title: Differential NT compatibility
milestones.deliverables: Pinned Windows corpus, legitimate intact drivers and per-contract differential evidence.

milestones.title: Advanced stacks and integrity
milestones.deliverables: Storage, filesystems, NDIS, WDF, graphics and ci.dll with normal trust checks.

known_limitations: Only the boot processor executes kernel code. A VM with multiple CPUs is not evidence of kernel SMP.
Firmware identity mappings remain active and pinned. Owned virtual memory, W^X enforcement and guard pages are pending.
No scheduler, NT IRQL, dispatcher, Object Manager, PE driver loader or NT exports are implemented.
No Windows binaries have been acquired, loaded or tested. No differential compatibility evidence exists.
Exceptions are terminal. Unwind consumption, persistent crash dumps and recoverable faults are pending.
Serial transport is specific to the QEMU PC COM1 configuration. No real-hardware support claim.
PFN allocation scans metadata under one ticket lock; fairness requires scheduling progress and bounded outstanding tickets.
Memory map limits are 256 KiB and 1024 descriptors; larger maps fail explicitly.

changes: Introduced C17 UEFI foundation and explicit boot ownership transaction.
Added checked map parsing, sparse PFN handles and concurrent host contracts.
Added CPU exception tables, serial records and versioned crash context.
Introduced compatibility source, technical portal and validation workflow.
